title: The Desert That Feeds the Jungle
hook: The Sahara sends 27 million tonnes of dust across the ocean to feed the Amazon.
script: The Sahara sends 27 million tonnes of dust across the ocean to feed the Amazon. Rainforest soil is poor, because heavy rain washes its nutrients away. The missing ingredient is phosphorus, and the dust carries it. So where does all that dust come from? Much of it comes from one dried lake bed in Chad. Once full of life, it is now feeding a jungle an ocean away. Could a desert and a jungle really depend on each other? They do, and a quiet wind links two of the most different places on Earth.
